data.remark:
Single learned recurrent primitive: a 2-layer unidirectional GRU cell computing cell(state, m, digit) = (state·R + m·digit) mod p entirely through trained weights, run over a fixed two-phase Horner schedule (phase 1 reduces a in-network; phase 2 streams b with m = a_red). No hand-coded modulus reduction against the challenge prime anywhere in the inference path; all parameters trained from random initialization by the author, no external pretrained weights.

Scope: operand encoding is fixed at 64 bits, targeting tiers 1–3; wider tiers are out of scope for this submission.

Acknowledgements: the cell formulation follows Marcos Costa Santos Carreira's public Zulip post (2026-07-15) and the organizers' clarifications in the same channel — it should not be read as independently conceived. Related independent work: NeuralHorner (Robert Sneiderman, github.com/Robby955/neural-horner) and the organizers' official dlp_grokking example. No code, weights, or text from any of these is used in this repository; full attribution and architectural differences are documented in the repository README.
